title: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
abstract: arXiv:2609.23989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Building general-purpose agents for industrial deployment requires integrating multiple capabilities, each typically acquired at a distinct stage of training. Yet there is currently no well-established recipe for Agent Continual Learning (ACL), with little understanding of the trade-offs among existing integration paradigms. To address this gap, we introduce ACLArena, a framework for comprehensively studying, analyzing, and evaluating ACL. We first build a sequential training pipeline and conduct an in-depth analysis that explains the mechanisms of forgetting and generalization from two complementary perspectives, the model level and the token level. Guided by these analyses, we systematically compare multi-teacher on-policy distillation, self-distilled fine-tuning, and model merging to assess their ability to recover previously learned capabilities while preserving newly acquired ones. tldr: ACLArena是一个系统研究智能体持续学习（ACL）的框架，从模型和token两个层面揭示遗忘与泛化机制，并系统比较多教师在线策略蒸馏、自蒸馏微调和模型合并等范式在多阶段后训练中平衡新旧能力的表现。
en_tdlr: ACLArena is a framework for systematically studying Agent Continual Learning (ACL), revealing forgetting and generalization mechanisms at both model and token levels, and comparing multi-teacher on-policy distillation, self-distilled fine-tuning, and model merging for balancing old and new capabilities in multi-stage post-training.
